data.gender_notes: Dasha is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dasha is derived from the Russian word ‘dar’ meaning ‘gift’ and ‘asha’ meaning ‘God’. The name represents the idea of a gift from God and is often given to girls in honor of the divine gift of life. The name Dasha carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dasha usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and blessings.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dasha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

It was a common name among the Russian population and was especially popular during the Soviet era when the government encouraged the use of traditional Russian names. Today, Dasha is still a beloved name among Russian Christians and is often given to girls in honor of their divine gift of life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dasha carries a deep spiritual significance as it reminds us that every human life is a gift from God, a divine blessing bestowed upon us. The name Dasha is a reminder to cherish and honor this gift, to live our lives in gratitude to God and to strive to live a God-centered life. It also reminds us of the promise of God's grace and the importance of seeking God's guidance and protection throughout our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Dasha in Christian context is believed to mean "Gift" or "Grace from God." It is a reminder of the precious gift of faith and the unending grace bestowed upon us by God.
